1: Launch of the New Battleship Macross
5:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)><ac(19)>We will now <im(1)>head out <im(2)>to #c[F07141]guard the launch
ceremony <im(3)>of the battleship Macross#c,
which has finally been completed.
6:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>For those unfamiliar with the #c[E2E258]Macross#c,
allow me to give a brief explanation.
7:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Ten years ago, a meteor crashed
upon South Ataria Island.
8:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Investigations revealed that this meteor
was in fact an alien warship
exceeding 1,200 meters in length.
9:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Through this, we also learned of a war
beyond our solar system between two
warrior races: Zentradi and Meltrandi.
10:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>The military at once drew up defense plans
against these aliens and, as their core,
repaired and refitted the fallen ship.
12:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Unknown technology wrought by alien
hands has been utilized in this warship.
13:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Space-jump navigation called 'fold',
a frame transforming to Attack Mode...
All impossible with Earth tech alone.
14:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>The #c[E2E258]Valkyries#c you fought alongside
were also built with this alien tech,
making them state-of-the-art machines.
15:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Some among you may not have known of
the #c[5E8FD8]Macross#c, but take this chance to learn
of it.
16:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Near South Ataria Island, where the
#c[5E8FD8]Macross#c launch ceremony is to be held, we
have detected <im(10)>#c[BE5050]Poseidal#c and <im(9)>#c[BE5050]Grados#c fleets.
17:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>As invading forces from outside the Earth
Sphere, their aim is likely to destroy the
#c[5E8FD8]Macross#c.
18:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Considering Earth possesses such unknown
power, this was naturally to be expected.
19:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>This is the first time #c[BE5050]Grados#c has been
confirmed on Earth. It seems what that boy
named Eiji said was indeed true.
20:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Their arrival with #c[BE5050]Poseidal#c is odd,
but...<im(5)><im(8)> we have no time to ponder it.
Combat has already begun on site.
21:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>This ship will rush to South Ataria Island.
We will cooperate with the local #c[5E8FD8]Valkyrie
squad#c to #c[F07141]defend the Macross#c.
22:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Furthermore, we have received word that
Orphan has begun surfacing in the Pacific.
23:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Because of this, Yuu Isami and Hime
Utsumiya have temporarily returned to the
#c[5E8FD8]Novis Noah#c. That is all.
24:
<op(34,1)><sp(2)>The #c[5E8FD8]Macross#c seems to be an <im(11)>important<im(12)> ship,
<of(1)>so please try not to let it get destroyed.
